g.text: “I had once screamed, gradually, I lost my voice.
I had once cried, gradually, I lost my tears.
My gaze is as steady as a monolith —
only perseverance remains in my heart.”
Quiet craft, built from first principles.
Native browsers without Electron overhead, local-first workspaces
for worldbuilders, zero-command peer-to-peer support, and
restrained desktop audio — built to endure rather than impress.
